sources.reading: Downloaded and text-extracted the complete 290-page author PDF. Read the cited statements and proof passages, including the complete-local-isometry lift, index comparison in Rauch, the polar density proof, Bishop–Gromov integration, and Cheng’s volume argument. Corrected typographical slips in the source by checking the equations and the independent Eschenburg treatment. Re-read the model-space passages (Examples 8.2.6-8.2.7, Proposition 15.3.1, §§20.1 and 24.1, 24.3) to back the three model-geometry suppliers added in the Step-3b b-leaf repair.

sources.reading: Downloaded and text-extracted the complete 77-page monograph. Read the Riccati comparison and Rauch statements, trace inequality, Bishop–Gromov polar integration, all cases of the §6 Toponogov support-function argument, and the §12 Myers–Cheng support maximum-principle proof. Its displayed (6.10) prints the opposite sign from its own differential-inequality proof and Corollary 6.3; the scaffold follows the proof and independently checks the sign against Lang Chapter 5. Re-read §1.1 and §5 for the sphere/half-space/flat-torus model-geometry suppliers added in the Step-3b b-leaf repair.

sources.reading: Downloaded and extracted the complete 144-page author-hosted lecture-note PDF. Read all proofs and definitions in Chapter 5 §§5.1–5.3, printed pp.63–71, including the lower-curvature signs (A_k),(H_k),(C_k), the balanced-segment subdivision lemma and the global shrinking-hinge proof. This independently resolves the sign contradiction in Eschenburg §6 but does not by itself supply the maximal-diameter sphere isometry.
